logic_evidence.roomzone_producer_and_gates: Recovered source at port/level-world/canonical_level_config_module_v1.cpp: CanonicalModuleV1::init_post first completes inherited ObjectBase::InitPost and Module visual/floor gates; it reads the SAME visual root world bounds, calls the generated RoomZone spawn service, and calls Zone InitWithBoundingBox plus Module backlink only when the actual spawned handle is cached and type==11. CanonicalRoomZoneV3::init_bounds stores the six source bbox values, computes dimensions/center, positions the zone and stores module38c only after success. source_has_inside_v104 is inclusive XY and ignores Z. source_has_been_visited_v104 reads the backlink's SAME Module visited3fc byte (moduleless source zones return true). source_update_v104 has camera-plane activation gates, then reads the same local-player position and sets the Module byte to visited only after the player is inside. The existing Map.Show collector in source_map_kernel_v1.cpp consumes definite live Level RoomZone visitation and actual object bounds/visibility; this producer does not duplicate that collector.
logic_evidence.decoded_root_candidate_evidence: FixedMapV1::Borrow exposes actual placed module roots, authored module occurrences, BRES views and transformed scene-instance matrices. source_map_decoded_room_zone_v1.cpp reproduces the source static-root box path for supported static meshes: transform each actual mesh AABB by its cached instance matrix, union child bounds, subtract the Module root position and transform by the cached root matrix. This implementation is a decoded root-bound candidate and exact HasInside subset; it does not claim that a source RoomZone factory handle/type 11 was published or that the candidate has current live visitation.

expected_behavior.page: Open and close the original MapSheet; render authored page art through the caller's retained source owner; project only marker records furnished by actual source owners on the same borrowed campaign and current camera frame.
expected_behavior.input: Dispatch only the original Legend and ResetZoom controls through source owner callbacks. A map-marker pointer release has no selection action because none is present in recovered source ActionScript/native producers.
expected_behavior.geometry: Use the actual ScreenArt RenderMap rectangle and the original CameraBase view/projection source map projection. No generated map, arbitrary scale, rectangular replacement or marker coordinates are created by this leaf.
expected_behavior.decoded_roomzone_subset: Each eligible source Module must supply its actual transformed-root AABB to the generated RoomZone; HasInside uses inclusive XY bounds and ignores Z. The existing Map.Show then partitions the live Level RoomZones by their same-Module visited3fc value and toggles/aggregates Level object bounds. The minimal decoded producer publishes exact root bounds and HasInside only; it leaves visitation unknown until the live Module/RoomZone association exists.

generic_main_marker_provider.composition_api: source_map_append_current_player_marker_v1(const CombatSession&, vector<SourceMarkerV1>&, error) synchronously appends only the source family-3 local-player marker, after validating the current Session actor/world/traits/binding lease; it rejects a duplicate same-family/source-id marker without changing the vector.
generic_main_marker_provider.owner: Reads CombatSession::player_id(), the same session PlayableActorWorld::traits(id), and the same world ActorState::transform.position; the emitted marker retains CombatSession::actor_binding_lease(). It checks that the actor pointer is the same record returned by that world, exact is_player trait, finite coordinates, update serial and binding-lease identity before publishing. Active combat/animation pose ownership is not a gate; the map marker is sourced from the live player world transform.
generic_main_marker_provider.coverage: Only the local-player family is produced. Generic PlayableActorWorld actors, traits and WorldObject transforms do not expose the exact recovered predicates for families 0,1,2,4,7,10,11,12,14-17 (quest, typed exits/objects, monster/merchant/questgiver, remote-player or PFWorld RoomExit), so those families remain absent rather than inferred from names/profile IDs.
generic_main_marker_provider.not_integrated: The owning page collector can synchronously call source_map_append_current_player_marker_v1 from its current CombatSession. The caller must ensure that is the same current gameplay Session as its frame. This feature cannot prove identity against the legacy SourceMapBorrowV1.local_player token, whose canonical Character owner has no published alias to the generic Session lease. No main/CMake wiring was changed.

decoded_fixed_map_roomzone_subset.source_rules: Uses FixedMapV1's actual module/mesh BRES and per-instance world matrices. uncertainties_and_gaps: The generic main owners expose authored ActorPopulation definitions/enrollment order, SourceModuleFloors/navigation, and live CombatSession transforms, but no complete typed current RoomZone visited/bounds list or exact Level-object bounds/visibility list. Parsed declarations and PF room metadata do not establish native RoomZone::HasBeenVisited/HasInside results; they are not substituted for those source facts. RuntimeSourceMapPageV1 still requires the full canonical SourceMapBorrowV1 and source Show/RenderMap/action owners, so the generic Session helper does not make that legacy page leaf independently playable.

Only local-player family3 is currently sourced from the generic main session. Monster, merchant, questgiver, remote-player, objective, typed map exit/object and PFWorld room-exit families require exact source classification/target/bounds predicates not represented by the generic actor/world fields. No marker was inferred from ActorDefinition.name, profileId, or a gametype string.

The family3 append helper is a caller-consumable collector component, but no production page collector currently composes it with the visible page and no same-session Map page integration or visual capture has run. The feature still does not claim readiness or playable integration.
The caller still must bind Map.Show/Hide and source map camera lifecycle to the same Level, player, save, quests, event owner and actual application zoom service.

Source map camera identity/frame publication and original marker producers are not connected to a production caller. The feature API rejects camera frame mismatch but cannot create missing source providers.
No per-marker click behavior was found in source. Marker selection remains absent by design; this is not a PC input adaptation or a gameplay selection feature.
No rendered original Map page reference or same-profile runtime capture was available; source geometry and helper tests do not prove visual fidelity or playable page integration.
